title: Understanding Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) updates the model parameters more frequently than Batch Gradient Descent. This frequent update can help in escaping local minima and finding a better global minimum.

title: Advantages of SGD
text: SGD can be more efficient than Batch Gradient Descent because it processes one training example per iteration, which can lead to faster convergence.

title: Comparing Loss Functions
text: Consider how the loss function behaves when using SGD versus Batch Gradient Descent. Which one is more likely to find a lower loss?
